_comment: Antigravity CLI (~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json, or .agents/plugins/<name>/mcp_config.json). It supports 'cwd' natively, so no sh -c wrapper is needed — but 'cwd' is a literal path and cannot read MCP_CLONE, so the clone path goes there instead of in the env block. Edit 'cwd' plus the two values marked <…>. PROJECT_ROOT is the repo you are editing, not the clone. DATABASE_PATH is deliberately absent: it defaults to <clone>/priv/mcp.db, which is what 'mix setup' migrates. MCP_LOG_FILE is relative and resolves against cwd.
